query_text:
I'm moving to Berlin, Germany on 2026-09-01 and need a 1-bedroom apartment for 2 adults with a maximum budget of €1,800/month all-in. Please compare these listings and recommend the best fit for a 30-minute transit commute to Alexanderplatz, noting any budget or lease issues:
1) Neukölln — €1,650/month, 52 m², 1 bedroom, 12-month lease, unfurnished, 35 min commute, pets allowed
2) Prenzlauer Berg — €1,850/month, 48 m², 1 bedroom, unfurnished, 22 min commute, no pets
3) Moabit — €1,700/month, 60 m², 1 bedroom, furnished, 28 min commute, pets allowed, 6-month lease
Rank them from best to worst for my situation, explain the tradeoffs, and suggest what I should compromise on if I want to stay under budget.

For a Friday movie night with two adults and one teen, please rank these 6 films by best fit for a fun, light, PG-13 viewing: 1) Galaxy Heist (122 min, sci-fi comedy), 2) Midnight Harbor (104 min, mystery thriller), 3) Summer Circuit (96 min, coming-of-age drama), 4) Dragon Lantern (118 min, fantasy adventure), 5) Paper Stars (89 min, romantic comedy), 6) Iron Relay (131 min, action). Preferences: minimal violence, some humor, not too sad, and ideally under 120 minutes. Give the top 3 picks, a one-sentence reason for each, and a short watch-order recommendation.

Between these three robot vacuums, which is the best fit for a 1,200 sq ft apartment with two cats and mostly hardwood floors? Please rank them, explain the trade-offs, and pick one under a $450 budget.

Options:
1) CleanBot S8 — $399, 2500 Pa suction, 2.5 hr runtime, self-empty base, 2-inch obstacle clearance, 1-year warranty
2) SweepMax Pro — $349, 3000 Pa suction, 1.8 hr runtime, no self-empty base, mopping feature, 0.8-inch obstacle clearance, 2-year warranty
3) DustAway X2 — $449, 2200 Pa suction, 3 hr runtime, self-empty base, quieter mode, 1.5-inch obstacle clearance, 1-year warranty

My priorities, in order, are pet hair pickup, low maintenance, and quiet operation.

For a family trip to Barcelona, Spain, I’m trying to book a 4-night hotel stay from 2026-05-14 to 2026-05-18 for 2 adults and 1 child (age 9), with a total lodging budget of €1,100. Please compare these options and recommend the best fit for a quiet, safe neighborhood with easy metro access, breakfast included, and a room that can fit a rollaway bed: 1) Hotel Alba — €210/night, Eixample, breakfast included, 24 m² room, metro 4 min walk, free cancellation; 2) Casa Mar — €185/night, Gothic Quarter, breakfast not included, 28 m² room, metro 2 min walk, no free cancellation; 3) Sagrada Suites — €245/night, Gràcia, breakfast included, 26 m² room, metro 6 min walk, free cancellation, family room available; 4) Port View Inn — €195/night, Barceloneta, breakfast included, 22 m² room, metro 8 min walk, free cancellation. I also want a brief explanation of which one is the safest value, which one best fits the budget, and a simple booking checklist for what to verify before paying.

Using this forecast for Melbourne, Australia from 2026-07-01 to 2026-07-05 (AEST), write a concise weather summary for someone planning an outdoor weekend event, pick the best day for being outside, and note any days to avoid.

Forecast:
- 2026-07-01: High 14°C, Low 7°C, Rain chance 20%, Wind 12 km/h, Partly cloudy
- 2026-07-02: High 12°C, Low 6°C, Rain chance 80%, Wind 28 km/h, Heavy rain
- 2026-07-03: High 13°C, Low 5°C, Rain chance 55%, Wind 18 km/h, Cloudy with scattered showers
- 2026-07-04: High 15°C, Low 8°C, Rain chance 10%, Wind 9 km/h, Sunny
- 2026-07-05: High 16°C, Low 9°C, Rain chance 15%, Wind 11 km/h, Mostly sunny

From this small e-commerce dataset, design a compact executive dashboard for a manager who wants to track performance from 2025-01 to 2025-06. Use USD and percentages. Data: Month,Revenue_USD,Orders,Returns
2025-01,42000,820,31
2025-02,39000,790,29
2025-03,45500,860,34
2025-04,47000,910,41
2025-05,51000,980,44
2025-06,49500,950,39
Please propose 3 visualizations that work well together, and for each one specify the chart type, what goes on the axes, and the main takeaway it should show. Include one chart for revenue trend, one for order volume and returns, and one chart using a derived metric you calculate from the table. Finish with 4 concise insights and point out any month that looks unusual.

I’m planning a 4-day solo trip to Kyoto, Japan from 2026-04-10 to 2026-04-13, with a total budget of ¥85,000 excluding flights. Please map out a day-by-day itinerary that balances temples, one food market, one low-key neighborhood walk, and one evening activity, with no more than 18,000 steps per day and at least one long lunch break daily. I prefer public transit, want to avoid overly crowded attractions before 10:00, and need one rainy-day backup option for each day. Include a rough budget breakdown by day, suggested transit approach, and a short packing checklist for spring weather.

Our product launch review is set for 2026-04-08 10:30-11:15 America/Los_Angeles with 6 participants: product manager, designer, engineer, sales lead, support lead, and me. Please draft a concise meeting agenda with time blocks, assign a likely owner for each agenda item, and add a short post-meeting action list with deadlines for the three highest-priority follow-ups. Constraints: keep the agenda under 45 minutes total, include a 5-minute buffer at the end, and make the wording professional but easy to paste into a calendar invite.

Using 2 chicken breasts, 1 can chickpeas, 3 cups spinach, 2 tomatoes, 3 cloves garlic, plain yogurt, and rice, suggest a 30-minute stovetop dinner for 2 people with step-by-step instructions, a short ingredient list, one lactose-free substitution, and approximate calories and protein per serving.

For a first-time visit to Porto, Portugal, build a 3-day walking itinerary for 2 adults from 2026-09-18 to 2026-09-20. We’ll stay near Ribeira, have a non-hotel budget of €240 total, love historic sites, local food, and scenic viewpoints, and want to keep walking under 12,000 steps per day. Please include morning/afternoon/evening plans, estimated transit or walking times, one rainy-day backup option for each day, and 5 practical neighborhood tips for getting around.

My Windows 11 Pro laptop (Dell XPS 13, 2022) stopped connecting to my home Wi‑Fi after I replaced the router with a TP-Link Archer AX55. The laptop sees the network, but I get "Can't connect to this network," and when it does connect, it drops again within a minute. Other devices in the house work normally. I already tried restarting both devices, forgetting and re-adding the network, updating the Wi‑Fi driver, and running the built-in network troubleshooter. Please give me a prioritized troubleshooting checklist, explain the most likely causes, and include the exact Windows settings to check before I consider resetting the whole PC.

Draft a professional cover letter for a mid-level product analyst role in Berlin, Germany, for someone with 4 years of experience in SQL, Tableau, A/B testing, and stakeholder reporting. The applicant is relocating in September 2026, is transitioning from retail analytics to SaaS, wants to emphasize measurable impact, and needs a tone that is confident but not flashy. Keep it under 350 words, include a brief opening hook, two quantified achievements, one paragraph on why this company type appeals, and a closing call to action. Avoid buzzwords and do not mention visa sponsorship.

Draft a detailed schedule for a 2-day remote onboarding workshop on 2026-03-18 and 2026-03-19, 9:00 AM–4:30 PM America/New_York. Include 3 breaks each day, a 45-minute lunch, time for introductions, product overview, role-specific training, Q&A, and a closing wrap-up. The group has 18 new hires across engineering, sales, and support, so balance the agenda across those audiences and keep individual sessions under 60 minutes.

Review this household expense table for a family in Toronto, Canada, and analyze spending patterns from 2024-01 to 2024-06 in CAD. Data: Month,Rent,Groceries,Transport,Utilities,EatingOut,Misc; 2024-01,2200,640,180,210,320,150; 2024-02,2200,665,175,205,340,160; 2024-03,2200,690,190,215,360,155; 2024-04,2200,720,195,225,390,170; 2024-05,2200,705,200,230,410,165; 2024-06,2200,730,205,240,430,180. Please calculate the total monthly spend, identify the top three cost drivers, summarize month-over-month changes, and recommend three specific ways to reduce total spending by at least 8% without changing rent or transport. Also note any category that looks unusually volatile and explain why.

Among these three software engineer offers, compare them side by side and recommend the best fit for someone who values work-life balance and learning: A) Bangalore, India — ₹24 LPA base, 10% annual bonus, ₹4 lakh stock vested over 4 years, 3 days/week in office, 45-minute commute, product fintech company; B) Pune, India — ₹21 LPA base, 15% annual bonus, no stock, fully remote, early-stage startup, occasional evening calls; C) Hyderabad, India — ₹23 LPA base, 8% annual bonus, ₹2 lakh joining bonus paid in year 1, ₹3 lakh stock vested over 4 years, 2 days/week in office, 20-minute commute, established product company. Please give a concise comparison table with estimated first-year compensation, call out the main trade-offs, and rank the options using this weighting: 40% compensation, 30% work-life balance, 20% growth, 10% commute.

Review this monthly budget and calculate the total income, total expenses, net surplus, savings rate, and how many months it will take to reach a $8,500 emergency fund if I save the entire surplus each month. Income: salary $4,200, freelance work $650, child support $300. Expenses: rent $1,550, groceries $420, utilities $180, transport $160, insurance $240, phone $75, subscriptions $38, student loan $310, dining out $190, miscellaneous $145.

Plan a 6-day self-guided trip to Kyoto, Japan for 2 adults and 1 teenager, staying within a total ground budget of USD 1,800 excluding international flights. We want temples, food markets, one day trip to Nara, minimal walking over 12 km per day, and one evening with a scenic train or river activity. Include a day-by-day itinerary, neighborhood suggestions for lodging, estimated local transit costs in JPY, a food budget, and a backup rainy-day plan. Also add a short packing list for early May weather and note which attractions should be booked in advance.

For a solo traveler landing at Schiphol Airport in Amsterdam, Netherlands, with one carry-on, a max budget of €25, and a preference for the simplest trip to Amsterdam Centraal, compare these options and tell me which one to take: 1) NS train — 17 min, €5.20, 10-minute walk from arrivals; 2) Airport Express bus 397 — 35 min, €6.50, stop 6-minute walk from arrivals; 3) taxi — 23 min, €42, pickup at arrivals; 4) rideshare — 28 min, €31, pickup at departures. Also give a one-sentence reason and note any trade-off I should expect.

I'm tutoring a 14-year-old for a 45-minute biology lesson on photosynthesis. Please explain the concept in simple, student-friendly language, then provide a 5-step mini lesson plan, 3 common misconceptions to address, and 5 practice questions with answers.

Using the product notes below, write a concise README for a small command-line app called LedgerLite. Include these sections in order: Overview, Installation, Quick Start, Configuration, Troubleshooting, and FAQ. Keep the tone friendly and plain, avoid jargon, and stay under 650 words.

Product notes:
- LedgerLite is a personal finance CLI for tracking income and expenses from a local CSV file.
- Command syntax:
  - `ledgerlite import transactions.csv` imports a CSV file with columns: date, description, category, amount.
  - `ledgerlite summary --month YYYY-MM` shows totals by category for that month.
  - `ledgerlite export --format json` exports the current ledger to JSON.
- Config file: `~/.ledgerlite/config.toml`
- Config options:
  - `currency = "USD"`
  - `date_format = "YYYY-MM-DD"`
  - `default_category = "Uncategorized"`
- Common errors to explain:
  - "File not found" means the CSV path is wrong.
  - "Invalid date format" means the date column must match the config date format.
  - "Permission denied" usually means the config file or target folder is not writable.
- Example use cases:
  - importing last month’s bank transactions
  - checking spending by category
  - exporting data for backup
- Audience: non-technical users who are comfortable using a terminal.

For a Windows 11 laptop with 8 GB RAM, I watch local MP4 and MKV files at 1080p and 4K with SRT subtitles. Recommend the best offline media player among VLC, mpv, and MPC-HC for low CPU use, and give a simple step-by-step setup for subtitle sync and audio equalizer, plus a short troubleshooting checklist if playback stutters.

Design a mobile QR scanner screen for a retail app with a clean dark theme, one-handed use, and a strong focus on fast scanning. Include these states: camera permission request, active scanner view with animated scan line and corner brackets, successful scan confirmation, invalid QR error, and scan history preview. The main screen should have a torch toggle, image-import button, manual code entry option, and a bottom sheet that shows the decoded content with actions to copy, open link, or share. Keep the layout simple, accessible, and optimized for use in bright outdoor lighting.

Looking over this project update, can you tell me whether we’re on track, what the current status is, and the top three next actions? Project: mobile app launch. Planned launch: 2026-07-15. Status notes: Design is 90% complete and awaiting final approvals; backend API auth is done but payments integration is still failing in staging; QA is 60% complete with 18 bugs open, 4 of them high priority; marketing assets are approved and the email campaign is scheduled for 2026-07-10; risks include the payment bug and one QA engineer being out from 2026-07-01 to 2026-07-05; budget is $120k total and $98k has been spent.

Draft a notification plan for my apartment inspection on 2026-07-14 at 09:30 America/New_York: I want 3 reminder notifications at 24 hours before, 2 hours before, and 15 minutes before, each with a calm professional tone, under 120 characters, and include a checklist mention for keys, ID, and payment receipt.

Review this household cash-flow snapshot and recommend how to allocate a monthly surplus of $1,200 between emergency savings, debt repayment, and retirement contributions. Use this data:
- Monthly take-home income: $6,800
- Fixed expenses: rent $1,800, utilities $220, groceries $650, transport $260, insurance $310, phone/internet $120, subscriptions $45, childcare $400
- Variable spending average: $720
- Debts: credit card A balance $4,200 at 22.9% APR, minimum payment $120; credit card B balance $1,900 at 18.4% APR, minimum payment $60; student loan $18,000 at 5.2% APR, minimum payment $190; car loan $9,600 at 6.8% APR, minimum payment $245
- Current emergency fund: $3,500
- Retirement contribution goal: at least 8% of income

Please calculate necessary monthly expenses, how much more emergency fund is needed to reach 3 months of necessities, a recommended month-by-month allocation for the next 6 months, and which debt to target first. Include clear reasoning and note any trade-offs between paying down debt faster and building savings.

For a 34-year-old with seasonal allergies, mild asthma, and a 5-day history of dry cough, sore throat, and low-grade fever (37.8°C max), taking only cetirizine 10 mg daily and no known drug allergies, please outline a non-emergency self-care plan for the next 72 hours, list which over-the-counter options are generally reasonable to discuss with a pharmacist, and give clear red-flag symptoms that would mean seeking urgent medical care. Keep it practical, include dose-range examples only if they are standard for adults, and note any interactions or cautions relevant to asthma.

In California, I signed a 12-month lease for a one-bedroom apartment in Los Angeles on 2025-03-01, and on 2025-05-20 my landlord texted that I must allow maintenance entry any day between 08:00 and 20:00, pay a $150 “administrative fee” for short-notice access, and accept eviction if I do not cooperate. I work from home, there is no emergency, and I want a calm, practical response. Please give me: (1) a plain-English checklist of the tenant-rights issues this situation raises, (2) the safest non-confrontational options I can take next, and (3) a short email I can send asking for lawful notice and removal of the fee.

Relocating to Porto, Portugal in 2026-09, I want you to compare these three 2-bedroom rental apartments and recommend the best fit for a family of three. Budget: up to €1,600/month including HOA but excluding utilities. Priorities: a maximum 25-minute metro commute to downtown Porto, good access to a primary school, at least 75 m², an elevator, a quiet street, and pet-friendly rules. Options: A) 78 m², 2nd floor, €1,450, 18-minute metro commute, 600 m to school, no elevator, pet-friendly. B) 84 m², 5th floor, €1,600, 22-minute metro commute, 350 m to school, elevator, not pet-friendly. C) 72 m², ground floor, €1,300, 30-minute metro commute, 900 m to school, elevator, pet-friendly. Please rank them, explain the trade-offs, and say which one you’d choose and why.

As a senior customer support specialist in Lisbon, Portugal with 6 years of SaaS experience, strong Excel and SQL skills, basic Python, and no university degree, I want to transition into a junior product operations role at remote-first companies hiring across Portugal or Spain. My target compensation is €32,000–€38,000 gross per year, I can study 8 hours per week for 10 weeks, and I need to avoid roles that require fluent Spanish. Please outline a realistic transition plan, the top transferable skills I should emphasize, a skill-gap matrix, and 3 resume bullet rewrites for my current job.

Hosting six friends for a vegetarian dinner on 2026-02-14 in a home kitchen, design a complete three-course menu (starter, main, dessert) that is gluten-free, nut-free, under $90 total, and can be prepared in under 2 hours by one person using only an oven, stovetop, blender, and one large pot. Include a shopping list with approximate quantities in metric units, a step-by-step prep timeline, and two swap options for anyone who wants extra protein.

For a 3-bedroom apartment in Lisbon, Portugal, draft a practical checklist for hiring a licensed plumber to fix repeated low water pressure and a slow kitchen drain, including likely causes, questions to ask before booking, what photos or measurements to gather, a fair quote-comparison template, and red flags that suggest the job may be more than a simple repair.

For a 2017 Honda Civic LX with 98,500 miles that’s used mostly for city driving, the engine idles rough for 10–15 seconds after cold starts, the check-engine light is off, fuel economy dropped from about 34 mpg to 28 mpg, and the last service was 14 months ago. I have a $600 repair budget and need the car to stay reliable for a 60-mile daily commute over the next year. Please rank the most likely causes, suggest the first five inspections or repairs in order, separate DIY-friendly items from shop-only jobs, and explain any warning signs that would mean I should stop driving it until it’s checked.
